description: List any app or game you built in the Appside public app catalog. No Appside store or account required. Supply plain-text metadata and your website or exact https://<account>.itch.io/<game> page (or App Store/Google Play listing for a store-only app). Returns an id and ownership token; publish the token then call verify_app. Nothing is public until verified; pending entries expire after 14 days.

contactEmail.description: Optional private contact, never shown publicly.

url.description: HTTPS app website on a domain you control, or the exact game page on your own itch.io subdomain. Each itch game path is a separate identity. Omit only for store-only apps.

webBuildUrl.description: HTTPS playable build on your verified hostname, an itch game page, or https://itch.io/embed-upload/<id>; itch game pages resolve to the browser upload at verification; click-to-load sandboxed Play.

name: register_app
